title: Multi-Merge và Remix
scope_items: Database Migration 00018: Created remix_blueprints table with workspace composite tenant keys, strict tenant RLS isolation (ENABLE + FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY), app_user and admin_user policies, composite foreign keys referencing workspaces, scripts, and assets, explicit decimal money columns, and reversible transactional down migration.

Acceptance Target 1 (One canonical similarity threshold): AI Remix output enforces strictly < 30.0% script similarity vs reference original across backend, web, and mobile (RULE-M07-003, PRD §23.7, Pack 04 §9.5.6). No separate 70% bypass threshold exists. If similarity >= 30%, generation is blocked with quality_state = 'rejected', 0 credits are deducted, and actionable guidance is returned.

Acceptance Target 2 (No unlicensed media bypass): Multi-Merge compliance checks (RULE-M07-008, SAFE-2026-02, EC-M07-M01) strictly prohibit bypassing detected copyrighted music or unlicensed media by accepting risk. Hard blocks require verified license evidence or asset substitution before export.

Acceptance Target 3 (Foreign/DRM source has usable error): Reference video URLs that are DRM-protected (Netflix, Disney+, Widevine, FairPlay), geo-restricted (Hulu, geo-blocked), or private/SSRF targets return structured domain errors (ERR_DRM_PROTECTED, ERR_GEO_BLOCKED, ERR_SSRF_BLOCKED) with actionable copy ('Cannot access video at this URL. [Upload video file instead] or [Try different URL]') and zero partial analysis (EC-M07-R01).
verified_sub_slices: Acceptance Target 1 Verified: multimerge_remix_test.go (TestAcceptanceTarget1_OneCanonicalSimilarityThreshold), Svelte test suite (production.test.ts), and Flutter test suite (ai_remix_view_test.dart) verify the canonical < 30.0% threshold, blocking generation and rejecting script similarity >= 30% with zero credit deductions.

Acceptance Target 2 Verified: multimerge_remix_test.go (TestAcceptanceTarget2_NoUnlicensedMediaBypass), web multi-merge page tests, and Flutter models verify SAFE-2026-02 compliance: detected copyright hard-blocks export and cannot be bypassed by acknowledging risk without verified license proof.

Acceptance Target 3 Verified: multimerge_remix_test.go (TestAcceptanceTarget3_ForeignDRMSourceUsableError), web URL validator tests, and Flutter widget tests verify structured errors for DRM, geo-blocks, and SSRF loopback/private IPs with actionable user instructions.
Migration 00018 Verified: migrator_test.go passes all 18 migrations including 00018_p4_04_remix_blueprints_and_multimerge.sql with bidirectional transactional tests and app_user RLS enforcement.
Protobuf Contracts Verified: check_proto.sh passes proto lint, code generation, zero-drift verification, buf breaking backward compatibility, Go vet/test, TypeScript vitest, and Dart test suites.

Quality Gates Verified: tooling/ci/check_d0.sh (docs & consistency), tooling/ci/check_go.sh (gofmt, vet, govulncheck, race detector), tooling/ci/check_node.sh (svelte-check, vite build, vitest tests, SSR smoke), and tooling/ci/check_flutter.sh (analyze fatal-infos/warnings, 146 unit/widget tests) all pass.

Live AI video generation models (Veo, Kling, HeyGen) require cloud production keys; mock provider adapters with realistic latencies and failure responses verified.
Production Clerk instance and webhook signing credentials for live multi-tenant JWT validation.

Migration 00018 schema, composite foreign keys, RLS policies (FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY), and narrow grants verified via dry-run and local migrator test; live multi-tenant PostgreSQL RLS suite runs in CI harness.
